summary: You can open a support ticket at Invardia straight from PIM Manager.

new.title: Get support from inside PIM Manager
new.text: A Get support button opens a support ticket at Invardia. You see and can edit everything before it is sent.

fixes.title: Smoother installation
fixes.text: The installation checks the administrators before it creates anything, remembers the licence file when resumed, and closes the temporary database firewall rule it opened.
